claims.text: The lower-adjoined family \(\{\bar s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq(i^j,b^a)\}\) minimally generates \(J_v\). [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 220-235]
If \(r=n-r\) and \(i=j\), the conjugate parameter \(v^\vee=v_{n-r,\;n-r+j-i,\;n-r-i+1,\;n}\) equals \(v\).
Under these hypotheses, partition conjugation induces a grading-preserving integral involution \(C:Q\to Q\), \(C([\bar s_\lambda])=[\bar s_{\lambda'}]\).
